vcu_g_0159_20000004.name: isr_usart2_rx_head
vcu_g_0159_20000004.description: Write index of the USART2 receive ring (0 to 249). USART2_IRQHandler stores each received byte at isr_usart2_rx_ring[index] and advances the index, wrapping to 0 after 249 (the test is index above 0xF9). Units: bytes. No reader in this packet.

vcu_g_0159_200019ba.name: isr_usart2_rx_ring
vcu_g_0159_200019ba.description: 250-byte receive ring for USART2. USART2_IRQHandler fills it byte by byte at the index isr_usart2_rx_head. The consumer (probably a frame parser) is not in this packet.

vcu_g_0159_20001018.name: isr_ertc_wakeup_count
vcu_g_0159_20001018.description: Number of ERTC wakeup interrupts since reset. ERTC_WKUP_IRQHandler increments it and it wraps at 255. Not read in this packet, probably a diagnostic counter.

vcu_g_0159_20001858.name: isr_can_last_error_code
vcu_g_0159_20001858.description: Last CAN error code, the LEC field (bits 4 to 6 of the CAN error status register, 0 to 7), latched by CAN1_SE_IRQHandler. can_get_tx_payload_for_id places it in the CAN payload; vcu_0159_080047ac clears it to 0.

vcu_g_0159_2000185b.name: isr_can_error_flag
vcu_g_0159_2000185b.description: Error-event flag set to 1 by CAN1_SE_IRQHandler. vcu_can_periodic_telemetry_tick tests it and clears it to 0 in the same call (probably so that a new error is reported once). Values 0 or 1.

vcu_g_0159_2000186f.name: isr_can_tec
vcu_g_0159_2000186f.description: CAN transmit error counter (TEC, bits 16 to 23 of the CAN error status register), latched by CAN1_SE_IRQHandler. vcu_0159_080047ac clears it; can_get_tx_payload_for_id places it in the CAN payload. Units: error counts.

vcu_g_0159_20001870.name: isr_can_rec
vcu_g_0159_20001870.description: CAN receive error counter (REC, bits 24 to 31 of the CAN error status register), latched by CAN1_SE_IRQHandler. vcu_0159_080047ac clears it; can_get_tx_payload_for_id places it in the CAN payload. Units: error counts.

vcu_g_0159_20001fb7.name: isr_input_event_code
vcu_g_0159_20001fb7.description: Input event code of the external interrupt lines. EXINT15_10_IRQHandler writes 2 and 4, and EXINT3_IRQHandler writes 5. vcu_0159_080047ac reads 4 and clears the code to 0. Probably a one-shot event code for the main loop.

vcu_g_0159_20001fb8.name: isr_exint_latch
vcu_g_0159_20001fb8.description: Input event latch set to 1 by EXINT15_10_IRQHandler. vcu_0159_080047ac and vcu_deep_sleep_enter_and_restore clear it, and vcu_pb14_timed_edge_sequence and vcu_state2_periodic_tick use it as an input level or event (probably the PB14 input). Values 0 or 1.

vcu_g_0159_20001fc6.name: isr_exint3_quiet_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001fc6.description: Quiet timer for the line 3 interrupt. EXINT3_IRQHandler and vcu_0159_080054ec reset it to 0, and vcu_0159_080047ac increments it every call and tests it against 500. Units: ticks.

vcu_g_0159_20001fea.name: isr_ertc_wake_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001fea.description: Wake flag set to 1 by ERTC_WKUP_IRQHandler. The loop in vcu_0159_0800d858 (probably the application main routine) waits until it is nonzero and then clears it. Values 0 or 1.
